usageNotes: Returns the list of available bulk-action sub-resources under /cluster/bulk-action/guest (e.g. start, stop, shutdown). Call this to discover which guest bulk-action verbs the cluster exposes before invoking a specific bulk-action endpoint. Requires no privileges — any authenticated user or API token can call it.
tips: The response is an index of child links (e.g. 'start', 'stop', 'shutdown') — follow the 'name' field in each item to construct the child endpoint path.
Because this endpoint has no parameters and requires only 'user: all' privileges, it is safe to call during bootstrap or health checks to confirm the bulk-action API surface is reachable.
